Skeletal Remains Found in Gujarat and Karnataka Murder Probes

Jamnagar police in Gujarat have recovered skeletal remains, leading to the arrest of a wife and two others in a case described as 'Drishyam'-like. Separately, DNA analysis has confirmed the identities of three skeletal remains found in Dharmasthala, Karnataka, as part of a mass burial investigation. The two events involve distinct murder investigations in different states.
